keyPoints: Rozmarra ke jeevan me humein mishran se kaam ki cheez alag karni padti hai, jaise gehu se kankad chunna ya doodh se malai nikaalna; sahi vidhi mishran ke gunon par nirbhar karti hai.
Bade-bade alag dikhne wale tukde haath se chun kar alag kiye jaate hain — ise hast-chayan (handpicking) kehte hain, jaise dal se kharab daane nikaalna.
Halke bhuse ko bhari anaaj se alag karne ke liye fatekne (winnowing) ka tareeka apnaya jaata hai jisme hawa halke kanon ko uda le jaati hai.
Chhalni (sieving) se aate se chokar ya ret se kankad alag kiye jaate hain — isme aakaar ke antar ka fayda uthaya jaata hai.
Chumbak se lohe ki keel ko ret ke mishran se kheenchkar alag kiya ja sakta hai; ye vidhi chumbakiya gun ke antar par kaam karti hai.
Paani me na ghulne wali cheezon ko chhanna (filtration) se aur bhari mitti ko thaharne (sedimentation) ke baad nikharne (decantation) se alag karte hain.
Aam galti: har mishran ke liye ek hi tareeka sochna; pehle mishran ke ghatakon ke gun dekho — aakaar, bhaar, ghulansheelta ya chumbakiya gun — phir vidhi chuno.

title: Prithakkaran ki Vidhi
